During the early morning an archivist arranged photographs on a long table. Each picture showed a different part of an old railway station. The archivist compared dates, checked handwritten labels, and placed uncertain records in a separate folder.

A carpenter carried a box of tools into a small theater. A wooden step had become loose near the stage, and the repair required several narrow brackets. After measuring twice, the carpenter adjusted the frame and tested the step before leaving.

In the public garden a volunteer counted butterflies near a row of flowering plants. Light rain began to fall, so the volunteer closed the notebook and walked toward the shelter. The observations would be added to the seasonal survey later.
